reviews.x: Nice deep waves...hair looks naturally wavy...gave it 3 stars because everytime i grab the handle to close and curl my hair it always presses on buttons because they are located on the handle and it's a easy click I keep accidentally turning off the iron by the time I'm done curling my hair I've at least turned it off half a dozen times gets really annoying

This one far exceeded the bedhead 10 to 1 in all aspects of styling.  I love how it handles like a flat iron ....therefore no burns on the skin. I wish that the wave could have been deeper but overall good product.

reviews.t: Good, works, and easy to use
reviews.x: I am not great at doing my hair, this was exactly what I needed to get some volume and texture without having to use a curler. I will state that these are waves and not a curler and will not look the same but if you need an easy tool to do your hair this is it. Everything works properly, buttons could be placed better but it isn’t a dealbreaker. Overall solid s style waver.
I’m so excited I got this crimper!!! I wanted a beach wave and this is what it gave me. The wave isn’t super deep but gives more of a relaxed beach wave. Not like a 80s crimper
Love this! I have fine/thin hair and all the curling tools I’ve used before left my hair ratty looking…this actually gave my hair curls..worth every penny!
Awesome easy way to get waves in my hair.

reviews.t: It keeps turning off. Default in the computer part or something
reviews.x: Bought this for my daughter and she said:  Really disappointed!! In the middle of trying to do my hair it keeps turning off... I thought my finger was accidentally hitting it  (since the off/on button is located in a super dumb area) was so excited to get the more natural waves than the waver I have that’s old... well returning it ASAP and sure glad I still have my HOT TOOLS wave maker DONT BUY! Junk. Keeps turning off by itself.

Omg!! Where has this product been all my life. I have super fine thin straight hair. I have used curling irons but my hair is so fine that it never holds. This product is super easy to use and is lightweight but not in a cheap way. The waves are still there 3 days later!!! I don’t feel like it is frying my hair like other products do. Worth every penny!!!  But a side not to the designers: put the digital buttons on the inside!

Nice crimper I would of gave it a 5 star if it doesn’t burn my scalp if too close on the sides my previous crimper did that but it wasn’t ceramic, and it got so hot it would burn your head if too close at least this waver you can actually hold the crimper part. This new one still can burn your head if too close from the sides but not as bad as my other one .. the waves can last 2 days no problem.
Love it works great...I have short hair and it takes 5 to 10 minutes and I'm done! The buttons are the only con they get in the way it would be better if they were on the inside.
This was easy to use and worked well out of the box but it just wasn't for me.  I ended up returning it and will continue to use my straightening iron to wave my hair.
The side towards your scalp doesn't get as hot as the irons which I needed, really like all the features with this returned another band so I could order this one

reviews.t: Good on healthy hair, but not for damaged hair
reviews.x: It makes good curls on my niece's hair, but not on mine tho. I think it doesn't work that well on damaged hairs. But works good on healthy hair.
This gets very hot so you have to be careful, but it works good.
I like this product for smaller waves in your hair.

I’m not sure if it’s the waver design or what but it definitely doesn’t like me. It ended up with my daughter and she didn’t like much either. Usually if something like this doesn’t work for me, it usually works for her, but not this time. Too bad to I love all things pink.

I was so excited to get this product but noticed after a few uses, (literally 3 uses) it was like the electrical cord connection went bad and the curling iron stopped working.  You had to hold the cord in a particular position for it to stay powered on which that started to happen the second time I used it and by the 3rd time there was no power to it at all.  Not happy with the product

I ordered this item a month ago , my first time using them were two days ago and it has a shortage. While I am I’m the middle of using them it cuts off ! You can also hear like a shock noise as your moving the irons. I was able to finish the look I wanted but I can’t use them again... I was only able to use one time. I need a refund or another curling iron ASAP 😤

I had this for a little over a month and it was great... until it stopped working. I turn it on, sometimes it gets to the point that it’s hot- but most times it just powers down. I can’t use it anymore. Very disappointed.
The product itself is good! I ended up returning it because my hair is still too short to use it without burning myself but I’d definitely buy again! Heats up fast and does what it’s supposed to do.

claims.text: Many reviewers find it easy to use and effective for creating natural-looking waves, especially on fine or thin hair.
Several reviewers complain that the buttons are poorly placed on the handle, causing the iron to accidentally turn off while styling.
Some reviewers note the waves are not very deep, though they still consider the results good.
A few reviewers mention the risk of burning the scalp if the iron is held too close to the head.
Some reviewers say it works well on healthy hair but not as well on damaged hair.
